sentences.text:
By this petition preferred under Article 226 of Constitution of India, the petitioner challenged the order dated 02.06.2025 (Annexure-P/3) passed by the Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue) Shajapur,
District Shajapur whereby he has been placed under suspension from the post of Sarpanch under section 39 (1)(a) of Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam,1993 (hereinafter referred as "the Adhiniyam" ).
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per provisions of section 39 (1)(a) of the Adhiniyam, the office bearer of panchayat can be placed under suspension only when the charge is framed in any criminal case mentioned in the said section.

It is submitted that in the present case, a case under section 137(2), 96, 64(2)(M) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Sanhita, 2023 and Section 5 (L)
read with section 6 of the Protection of Children from NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:17255 2 WP-20153-2025 Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 has been registered against the petitioner at Police Station- Barotha, District- Dewas but no charge has been framed.
3 .

sentences.text: The respondents have filed the reply to the petition but nowhere therein it has been stated as to whether any charge has been framed against the petitioner.
The petitioner has made specific avernment in the petition that no charge has been framed in the criminal case.

sentences.text: have only stated that the criminal case has been registered against the petitioner and upon completion of the investigation charge sheet has been filed before the Court concerned but it has not been stated whether any charge has been framed or not.
The reply is silent on the said aspect.
The petitioner therefore could not have been placed under suspension under Section 39(1)(a) of the Adhiniyam, 1993.

4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, it is apposite to refer relevant provision of section 39(1)(a) of the Adhiniyam, which reads as under:-
"39. Suspension of office-bearer of Panchayat.

- (1) The prescribed authority may suspend from office any office-bearer,-
(a) against whom charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under [Chapters V-A, VI, IX], IX-A, X, XII, Sections 302, 303, 304-B, 305, 306, 312 to 318,
366-A, 366-B, 373 to 377 of Chapter XVI, Sections 395 to 398, 408, 409, 458 lo 460 of Chapter XVII and Chapter XVIII of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (XLV of 1860) or under any Law for the time being in force for the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:17255 3 WP-20153-2025 prevention of adulteration of food stuff and drugs, [suppression of immoral traffic in women and children, Protection of Civil Rights and Prevention of Corruption];
5.

Chapters V-A, VI, IX], IX-A, X, XII, Sections 302, 303, 304-B, 305, 306, 312 to 318,
366-A, 366-B, 373 to 377 of Chapter XVI, Sections 395 to 398, 408, 409, 458 lo 460 of Chapter XVII and Chapter XVIII
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text:
Upon perusal of the aforesaid provision, it is manifest that Prescribed Authority may suspend any office bearer against whom charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under the provisions mentioned in the IPC or any law for the time being in force.
6.
Since, the charge has not been framed in the criminal case against the petitioner, the impugned order of suspension is patently contrary to the provisions of section 39(1)(a) of the Adhiniyam.
The impugned suspension order is quashed.
Liberty is granted to the Prescribed Authority to pass fresh order of suspension after framing of charge in accordance of law.
